notes: ACCESS: tier (a) only - direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) + bs4 parsing, no block encountered, Chrome/Playwright not needed. robots.txt checked first: User-agent:* Allow:/ with a broad Disallow list (checkout/app/bin/customer/catalog/ etc, none targeting Claude/anthropic bots), so tier (a) was clear. TREE METHOD: union of (1) homepage mega-menu (md-top-menu-items, 3 levels: L1 Furniture/Homeware/Kids/Outdoor/Summer Sale/New Arrivals, L2, L3) and (2) media/oc/sitemapoc.xml which revealed a 4th hierarchy level not shown in the rendered mega-menu (e.g. Bed Linen > Duvets & Covers, Bath Linen > Towels, Curtains & Blinds > Curtains vs Curtain Rods & Accessories, Living Room Storage > Shoe Racks / Side Boards, Bathroom Storage > Organisers / Waste Bins, Laundry > Laundry Hampers / Clothes Hangers, Table Linen & Accessories > Table Covers / Placemat & Runners / Napkins & Accessories). Every leaf's h1 and canonical were confirmed to match the requested node before recording. Sitemap alias/duplicate paths (e.g. /ae-en/home-linen/... without the homeware/ prefix, /ae-en/national-day-53/homeware/home-linen, /ae-en/outdoor-collection/home-linen, /ae-en/back-to-school/kids-homeware/kids-bathroom-storage) were treated as the same node reached via a promo/legacy path and not recorded separately (duplicate-prevention rule). Deepest-leaf child pages were spot-checked with no level-5 children found via sitemap prefix search. QTY METHOD: Magento 'power-listing-toolbar' div.count text, exact pattern 'N Item(s)' rendered server-side in the raw HTML (verified this is the true product-listing total, not a wishlist/filter badge count which uses a different span.count element and gave misleading numbers on Living Room Storage and Bathroom Storage until the Item(s) toolbar pattern was isolated). Where a parent had complete/matching child coverage (Bed Linen 91=40+5+6+3+23+14; Rugs & Mats/Floor Coverings 4=3+1; Curtains & Blinds 12=1+11) the parent was recorded as a grouping row only per the parent-URL rule. Bath Linen's 3 known children (Bathmats 13 + Bathrobe 0 + Towels 67 = 80) do not sum to the parent's own 95, meaning ~15 products (mostly 'Bath Sheet' variants) sit directly under the parent with no dedicated child URL; per the parent-URL rule (do not add parent URL when valid subcategories exist) those 3 children were still recorded and the parent left as a grouping row only - this is a known, disclosed gap, not fabricated data. EXCLUDED (checked and rejected): Curtain Rods & Accessories (11, homeware/decor-furnishing/curtains-blinds/curtain-rods-accessories) - curtain hardware per textile.md sec5. Waste Bins (11, bath-laundry/bathroom-storage/waste-bins) and Clothes Hangers (0, bath-laundry/laundry/clothes-hangers) - neither fits storage.md's containment/organization definition (trash receptacle and a bare hanger are not listed anywhere in storage.md; excluded, not just low-confidence, since qty for hangers is 0 anyway and waste bins have no rules basis for inclusion). Bath Accessories (110: soap dishes, toilet-brush holders, waste bins, tumblers, dispensers, cotton jar) - decorative bathroom accessories, neither textile nor storage. Bathroom Cabinet & Mirrors (0) and Ladders & Stools/Tall Hangers (2, step ladders) - furniture-adjacent, not storage. Kids Accessories (5: lunch box, folder, sipper, glasses), Wall Decor (31: mirrors/wall clocks/wall art, no fabric wall hangings found), Garden (98: planters/plants/stems, no storage items found on spot check), Home Decor/home-accessories (89: candles, vases, figurines, resin decor - contains 3 desk-organiser SKUs but those are already captured under the dedicated Stationary node so the bulk decorative node is excluded), Home Fragrances (both paths, 0 and 71 items: candles/diffusers), Outdoor Accessories (1: outdoor lamp - lighting), Furniture>Outdoor (4: bar table, solar end table, tea set, sofa set - furniture), Furniture>Kids & Teens (0), all Furniture bedroom/sofa-seating/living-room(non-storage)/dining-room subcategories - furniture per site hierarchy. Summer Sale (462), New Arrivals/latest-products (498) and the top-level Outdoor collection (outdoor-collection, 30) were excluded as promotional/cross-category collection landing pages, not standard taxonomy nodes (textile.md sec27 / storage.md sec35). LOW-CONFIDENCE ITEMS: Napkins & Accessories (3 items: 2 napkin rings [hardware, not textile] + 1 apron [genuine textile per textile.md sec8]) kept as a Textile row with confidence LOW and a flag, rather than dropped, since it is a genuine leaf node with mixed content and no way to split it further on-site. Living Room Storage > Side Boards (1 item) kept as Storage with confidence MEDIUM: a sideboard is normally Furniture (storage.md sec21/27) but the site's own hierarchy places this specific SKU under the Storage branch (furniture/living-room/storage/side-boards), and storage.md sec21 says to prefer the site's explicit categorization. Stationary (homeware/general-accessories, 1 item: Renata Desk Organiser Set of 4pcs) kept as Storage with confidence MEDIUM: category display name does not say storage but its sole product is a desk organiser (storage.md sec7). Kids Linen (kids/kids-linen, 1 item: Fun Paw Playmat 150cm, 100% polyester per its own product page) kept as Textile confidence MEDIUM - a fabric children's playmat fits textile.md sec20 children's textiles by material+purpose even though 'playmat' is not itself listed.
